t.zh: 标定件上有一条已知划痕。质检员给了两次拍摄的差值图，要求同一个门槛都能留下划痕、排除噪声。
t.en: A calibration part has a known scratch. Use one threshold on both measurements to retain the scratch and reject noise.

brief.zh: 用一个固定门槛复现标定件上的目标标记。
brief.en: Use a single fixed threshold to match the calibration masks.

naiveWhy.zh: 第一张图看起来清楚时，另一张图的噪声仍可能超过同一个门槛。
naiveWhy.en: A threshold that looks clear in one image may still flag noise in another.

hint.zh: 找出所有已知完好格中最大的差，以及划痕上最小的差。
hint.en: Find the largest difference on an intact cell and the smallest difference on a scratch.

after.zh: 只有噪声与划痕的差值范围分开时，一个门槛才能同时避开误报与漏报。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A single threshold avoids false alarms and missed defects only when the noise and scratch magnitudes are separated. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
